meta.title: A template already used by the RFQ is offered but disabled
gaps: Identify the RFQ's automatically selected template T and reuse its name to target the same option in the other stage's picker.
Verify that T is offered but disabled, hover it to assert 'Template used in RFQ has already been selected', and confirm that clicking it does not apply it.
